title: User Registration with Valid Email and Password
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid email, name, and password.

steps.description: Navigate to user registration API endpoint.
Submit registration details with valid email, name, and password.
Verify registration API returns success status and user is created.

title: User Registration with Invalid Email Format
description: Verify that registration fails when the email format is invalid.

steps.description: Submit registration request with invalid email format.
Verify the registration API returns an error related to invalid email.

title: User Authentication with Correct Credentials
description: Verify login succeeds for user with correct email and password credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to login API.
Provide valid user email and password.
Submit login request.
Verify login is successful and authentication token is returned.

title: User Authentication with Incorrect Password
description: Verify login fails when password is incorrect.

steps.description: Submit login with valid email but incorrect password.
Verify login API responds with authentication failure.

title: Profile Update with Valid License Verification Details
description: Ensure user can update profile including license type and upload license image.

steps.description: Send profile update request with complete details including licenseType and licenseImage.
Verify profile update succeeds and data is persisted.

title: Profile Update with Missing Required Fields
description: Verify profile update fails or handles gracefully when important fields like streetAddress are missing.

steps.description: Submit profile update with missing streetAddress or other required address fields.
Verify API returns an appropriate validation error.

title: Create Vehicle Listing with Valid Data and Multiple Images
description: Verify a vehicle listing can be created successfully with all required fields and multiple image URLs.

steps.description: Send new vehicle listing with valid fields: title, description, category, specs, address, and imageSrcs including multiple images.
Verify listing creation API returns success and listing details are stored.

title: Create Vehicle Listing with Missing Mandatory Fields
description: Verify the API rejects listing creation when mandatory fields such as category or price are missing.

steps.description: Attempt to create vehicle listing omitting required fields like category or price.
Verify that the API returns appropriate validation error messages.

title: Update Vehicle Listing with Valid Modifications
description: Ensure vehicle listing details can be updated successfully using valid data.

steps.description: Update existing vehicle listing using listingId with new valid details.
Verify the update API success response and that changes are correctly saved.

title: Reservation Creation with Correct Total Price Calculation
description: Verify that creating a reservation calculates total price accurately including insurance fees.

steps.description: Create reservation with listingId, startDate, endDate, insuranceType and insuranceFee.
Verify the totalPrice field reflects correct calculation including insurance fee and any other applicable fees.

title: Reservation Creation with Invalid Date Range
description: Verify reservation fails or returns error when endDate is before startDate.

steps.description: Attempt to create reservation with endDate earlier than startDate.
Verify API returns an error indicating invalid date range.

title: Update Reservation Status to Confirmed
description: Ensure reservation status can be updated successfully from pending to confirmed.

steps.description: Send status update request for reservation to change status to confirmed.
Verify status update API succeeds and reservation status changes accordingly.

title: Submit Review Post-Trip with Valid Rating
description: Verify that users can submit reviews only after the trip has ended with valid star ratings between 1 and 5.

steps.description: Submit a review for a completed listing specifying a rating from 1 to 5, and optional text.
Verify review API accepts the review and stores it successfully.

title: Submit Review with Invalid Rating Value
description: Verify the system rejects review submissions with rating outside permitted range (1-5).

steps.description: Submit a review with rating = 0 or rating = 6.
Verify the review API returns validation error for invalid rating.

title: Real-Time Chat Message Exchange Between Users
description: Verify users can create/get chat sessions and send messages successfully with timestamps and read receipts.

steps.description: Create or retrieve chat session with another user.
Send a text message through chat.
Verify message is delivered, stored, and includes timestamp and read receipt data.

title: Notifications Retrieval with Filtering and Bulk Update
description: Verify user can retrieve notifications filtered by read/unread status and perform bulk state update.

steps.description: Retrieve notifications with unread=true filter and specify limit.
Verify only unread notifications up to limit are returned.
Perform bulk update to mark multiple notifications as read.
Verify bulk update request succeeds and notifications states are changed.

title: Add and Remove Vehicle Listings from Favorites
description: Verify users can add listings to favorites and remove them correctly with API confirmation.

steps.description: Send request to add a specific listing to favorites.
Verify API confirms addition and listing appears in favorites.
Send request to remove the listing from favorites.
Verify removal confirmation and listing is no longer in favorites.

title: Google Places API Address Autocomplete Validation
description: Verify that submitting partial location input returns accurate and relevant address suggestions.

steps.description: Query address autocomplete API with valid input string, suburb, and state.
Verify API returns list of relevant address suggestions.

title: Image Upload to Cloudinary with Valid File
description: Verify that image uploads succeed when valid image file is submitted via Cloudinary integration endpoint.

steps.description: Upload supported image file via multipart/form-data to image upload API.
Verify API returns success and provides image URL.

title: Image Upload with Unsupported File Type
description: Verify that image upload fails gracefully when submitting unsupported file types.

steps.description: Attempt to upload a non-image or unsupported format file to upload API.
Verify API returns appropriate error about invalid file type.

title: Data Synchronization Success Between MongoDB and Supabase
description: Verify that data synchronization API correctly syncs specified table data with limit applied without conflicts.

steps.description: Trigger data synchronization for a selected table with a given limit.
Verify synchronization completes without errors and data is consistent in both databases.

title: Data Synchronization Status Retrieval
description: Verify retrieval of synchronization status via the sync status API endpoint.

steps.description: Send request to get synchronization status.
Verify status response includes recent sync activities and is consistent.
